parameters.notes:
THIS IS WHY THE WORKFLOW NEVER RUNS.

The n8n Trigger node reports lifecycle events for the workflow it LIVES IN, not for other workflows on the instance. Its own docs say "Triggers when workflow version is published" - meaning this one. So it can only fire when Auto Export Workflow on Publish is itself published, never when server-query, dml or hydrate-guide are. It also means $('On Workflow Publish').first().json.workflowId always resolves to this workflow's own id, so the export would fetch the wrong workflow even if it did fire.

Verified 2026-08-15: server-query was published three times in one session and nothing was recorded here, against a control of 10550 executions instance-wide. Zero executions since created 2026-07-23.

Kept deliberately (task 253) - it is inert and the Export and Git Push command is a good starting point. To actually work this needs either a schedule trigger polling public.workflow_entity.updatedAt, or the export folded into the deploy script so git records what was deployed rather than needing to be kept in sync separately.

parameters.query: {{ "SELECT o.name FROM knowledge_base.objects o WHERE o.platform = 'n8n' AND o.type = 'workflow' AND o.name = '" + $json.workflowName + "' AND (o.id IN (SELECT object_id FROM knowledge_base.step_dependencies) OR o.id IN (SELECT target_object_id FROM knowledge_base.object_dependencies)) AND (o.notes IS NULL OR o.notes->>'tech_debt' NOT LIKE '%dead%')" }}

parameters.command: ={{ "cd /home/n8n/wf-server && source .env && curl -s -H 'X-N8N-API-KEY: '$N8N_API_KEY https://n8n.whatsfresh.app/api/v1/workflows/" + $("On Workflow Publish").first().json.workflowId + " | jq '.' > n8n/workflows/" + $json.name + ".json && git add n8n/workflows/" + $json.name + ".json && git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m 'chore: auto-export " + $json.name + " on publish' && git push)" }}
